items.title: DDoS defender targeted in 1.5 Bpps denial-of-service attack
items.description: A DDoS mitigation service provider in Europe was targeted in a massive distributed denial-of-service attack that reached 1.5 billion packets per second. [...]

items.title: ZDI-CAN-27358: Fuji Electric
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Rocco Calvi (@TecR0c) with TecSecurity' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-09-10, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-01-08 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
